svg.title: on the whole summable family, not on an arbitrary finite prefix. Let ψi(r, b; z) be the installed fine-gradient column for a coarse residue r, curvature type b, direction i, and unwrapped displacement z. These columns are the product of the fine frame inverse, the differentiated linear tower, and the coarse frame. Whenever the stationary-column construction uses two curvature legs, its dependent-momentum join is precisely (TEL1)–(TEL3), with the retained Taylor orders stated there. On harmonic input the unmodified tower has residue- independent total columns. Install it on a one-site coarse torus. Its output is then constant on the fine torus; a fine difference of that output is zero. The intertwining identity between the differentiated column and the fine difference consequently gives X
